Question 11
?

What is the parametrization of the curve r(t)=⟨t4,12t4+2,3−t4⟩, t≥0, by its arc length s?

a
R(s)=13⟨2s,s+6,9−2s⟩
b
R(s)=14⟨2s,3s,2−3s⟩
c
R(s)=13⟨s,2s−3,−2s⟩
d
R(s)=13⟨s,2s+3,2s−3⟩
e
R(s)=14⟨3s,s,1−6s⟩
Submit
